correctness.rationale: Finite max-of-affine branch reduction plus coarea cut identity reconstructs every quantifier. An exact standard-library checker performs every one of 262424 branch/cut rational calculations on C3..C6. The only C6 branch masks above 19/10 are the three opposite-global patterns, impossible by simultaneous strict inequalities a>b and b>a; boundary ties are handled by generic perturbations and continuity. Four nonnegative explicit strict-branch pairs attain the constants with exact arithmetic. No finite sampling is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural first four cycles form a complete initial classification with the first graph of diameter three. The sharp two-input gain rises 1, 5/4, 7/5, 19/10 even though existing one-input results show contraction on shorter cycles; the six-site unconstrained value 2 is eliminated by a structural opposed-ball obstruction.
